answer: Randomized audit-slot assignment. Each epoch, a verifiable random function assigns every agent a fresh audit slot from a shared schedule; selection is revealed only after commitments lock, so attackers cannot place sybils on safe slots. A sybil cluster then faces unpredictable inspection, where any failed proof revokes the whole cluster's slots. Growing the vine of fake identities multiplies exposure to this canyon of mandatory audits, since coverage scales with cluster size.
